lithium.headline_note: 253090 (ore and concentrate) is queried and published as its own stage but is deliberately kept out of the headline. It is a mixed-merchandise population that only becomes comparable with the refined stages once the page offers stage selection, and adding it now would move published HHI/CR3 figures. Revisit when the headline is relativised by stage; until then critical-minerals/data/catalog.json headline_hs_codes must match this list exactly, and pipeline/tests/test_strict_pipeline.py enforces that.
